title: Sharing the Good News in “All the Languages of the Nations”
theme: “Ten men out of all the languages of the nations will take . . . hold of the robe of a Jew.”​—ZECH. 8:23.
focus: Appreciating the role of Jehovah’s people in the fulfillment of Zechariah 8:23.
subheadings: REACHING “TEN MEN OUT OF ALL THE LANGUAGES”
MAKING JEHOVAH’S NAME KNOWN AMONG THE NATIONS
review_questions: Who are represented by the “Jew” and by the “ten men” mentioned at Zechariah 8:23? Your answer
